title: The 5 Jobs Every Manager Does | Principles of Management Ep 14
description:
Ravi is opening a second Chai Corner, and his to-do list is a mess. In Episode 14 of our Principles of Management series, we use the new outlet to learn the functions of management: the core jobs every manager does, again and again.

You will learn Luther Gulick's POSDCORB from 1937 (planning, organizing, staffing, directing, coordinating, reporting and budgeting), why most books today use five functions (planning, organizing, staffing, directing and controlling), the one simple question each function answers, why the five work as a cycle, and why coordination is called the essence of management.

In this video:
0:00 A second outlet, one messy list
0:20 Not more jobs, the right order
0:24 What are the functions of management?
0:32 Gulick's POSDCORB (1937)
0:45 Today's five functions
0:54 Five functions, five questions
1:27 Why it is a cycle
1:37 Coordination, the essence of management
2:01 Results, and what comes next
2:12 Quick check
2:24 Recap
